One agent harness, with skills and MCP servers

Agent Harness Workflow

Click a step, or press Play. The diagram shows who is talking, and the message pops up below. Made-up data; nothing calls a real service.

    Setup

    Each vendor builds and runs its own MCP server. Your harness just lists where they are. New ability (hotels, calendar): add one more vendor’s MCP server. New know-how (a company travel policy): add one more skill.

    // harness config
"mcpServers": {
  "weather": { "url": "https://mcp.skycast.example",   "apiKey": "…from SkyCast" },
  "flights": { "url": "https://mcp.flyfinder.example", "apiKey": "…from FlyFinder" },
  "booking": { "url": "https://mcp.tixpro.example",    "apiKey": "…from TixPro" }
}
    Who does what
    PartJob
    HarnessRuns the loop, holds the conversation, routes tool calls, asks you before risky actions
    SkillsInstructions for a kind of task (“how we book travel”), loaded only when needed
    ModelDecides which tools to call and writes the answer
    MCP serversOne per vendor; each wraps that vendor’s service and does the actual work
